source_text: Dominati sunt filii Israel in omni terra eius. Omnis regio terrena terra Seon dicitur; Christus et ecclesia dominantur in omni terra eius cum peccata vincunt.
pass_a_gloss: Dominated sons of-Israel in all land his. Every region earthly land of-Sihon is-called; Christ and church dominate in all land his when sins they-conquer.
pass_b_english: [[Israel dominated all his land >> Bible:Numbers 21:24-25]]. Every earthly region may be called Sihon’s land; Christ and the church dominate it when they conquer sins.
